description: Negative: Pod container missing required ldp:contains (empty pod)
shaclConstraintViolated: A Cascade Pod root container must contain at least one resource via ldp:contains. An empty pod has no clinical utility.
notes: Tests that an empty pod container with no resources is rejected. A valid Cascade Pod must contain at least the profile and manifest resources. The invalid serialization is authored, but no SHACL shape targets ldp:BasicContainer in any Cascade vocabulary, so nothing rejects it yet and the runner reports this fixture as UNSHAPED. It becomes a live negative the moment a pod-container shape exists.
